commit.message:
Remove em dashes from the deposit documentation

The accompanying manuscript had its em dashes removed as a matter of house
style; these documents are reached from the same DOI, so they get the same
treatment. 27 instances across README, DATA, REPRODUCE and PRESPECIFICATION,
plus the title line of CITATION.cff.

Done by hand. Three automated passes were tried and all three were discarded:
a blanket comma substitution produced comma splices, a smarter one produced
nested parentheses and colons before conjunctions, and a third paired dashes
across list items and table rows, opening a parenthesis in one row of DATA.md's
licensing table and closing it in the next. At 27 instances the hand edit is
cheaper than a rule that has to be right about markdown structure.

Table rows, fenced code blocks, and every aligned-whitespace column are
byte-identical; the manifest is regenerated for the six edited files.
